name: kimai-mcp-server
description: MCP server for self-hosted Kimai time-tracking instances.
long_description: Connect Claude to your self-hosted Kimai time-tracking instance. 63 tools covering timesheets, customers, projects, activities, tags, users, teams, invoices, rates, comments, expenses, tasks, absences, and holidays. 28 tools are read-only. 24 write tools each require explicit authorization fields and save a JSON backup before reporting success. 11 delete tools additionally require KIMAI_ALLOW_DELETE=true, and the three cascading deletes snapshot every dependent timesheet first.

base_url.title: Kimai Base URL
base_url.description: Your Kimai URL without a trailing slash, for example https://example.kimai.cloud

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Generate an API token in your Kimai user profile (API Access)

timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: HTTP timeout for Kimai API requests, minimum 1000

allow_delete.title: Enable delete tools
allow_delete.description: Allow the 11 delete tools to run. Deleting a customer, project, or activity also deletes its timesheets. Leave off unless you need it.
